rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_constrained.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.2, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-4 fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained breast (search-20260703-01), val_n=200. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) TRAJECTORY iter->ssim/psnr/rmse/hr: 1(relax0.5,init_t0.7)->0.7220/27.35/1.465e-2/0; 2(relax1.0,init_t0.7)->0.8199/27.62/1.420e-2/0; 3(relax1.0,init_t0.4)->0.8946/27.93/1.371e-2/0. init_t 0.7->0.4 lifted SSIM +0.075 and cut RMSE 3.5%; MONOTONE improvement on SSIM+RMSE+PSNR as I push toward FBP. (2) FAILURE MODE: PSNR still ~8.4dB under the calibrated FBP baseline (~36.3) -> hr=0. The Mayo wavelet prior (out_scale 0.05 vs breast mu~0.5, 10x mismatch) sets a hard RMSE floor; each reverse-diffusion step from init_t injects mis-scaled prior HU that full DC only partly removes. dc_relax saturated at 1.0; init_t is the live RMSE-down axis and has NOT plateaued (iter2->3 still gained). (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_init_t 0.4 -> 0.2 (embed FBP even closer to t=0 -> even fewer/smaller prior perturbations, DC-anchored FBP structure dominates). ALL else identical to iter-3 (steps8, eta1.0, dc1, n_cg5, relax1.0). (4) HYPOTHESIS: init_t 0.4->0.2 cuts RMSE below iter-3's 1.371e-2 and raises SSIM/PSNR further because the recon approaches a DC-cleaned FBP with negligible mis-scaled-prior drift. hr likely still 0 (Mayo-prior-on-breast is FBP-bounded: as init_t->0 the recon limits to the DC-projected FBP itself, which cannot BEAT the FBP baseline it is scored against) -- confirming the fastdiff-family FBP-bounded verdict on breast IS the finding. FALSIFIER: if RMSE >= 1.371e-2 (init_t plateaued/reversed), the DC-cleaned-FBP limit is reached -> iter-5 tests fd_recon_eta lower (kill DPS guidance from the mis-scaled score) as the last prior-suppression axis, then the run documents the structural hr=0 ceiling. (5) BUDGET: lower init_t = FEWER steps -> runtime <= iter-3 160.6s, well inside 1200s / 1800s kill. val=ALL 200 seed-20260703 cases. (6) Loop continues; iter-5 self-dispatched on landing.
